content: An'kɔɔb nsambwaar mà nkyɛl a Nzam
Apan mɛ kàwem ndaa a ngwal yàfü idwà yàmutɛn a akyeey nsambwaar naa: « Làkyen kàlatyaaŋ an'kɔɔb nsambwaar mà un'fur a nkyɛl a Nzam u mɛɛn! »
Un'kyeey wàtàtwɛb kàkyen anà kàtyaaŋ kɔɔb ande u mɛɛn. Apan inkyär ibe anà byà usaay byàtoo u ndür a baar abà bàkäl anà inyɛm a ntsür anà bàfakömà idiim awa.
Un'kyeey wàyweel kàtyaaŋ kɔɔb ande u ngyäl a kölàköl. An'dà màbulà asànaa an'kil a un'kü anà indiir byanswà byàkäl uboo a an'dà byàkyer akwà.
Un'kyeey wàtär kàtyaaŋ kɔɔb ande u ngyäl anà u ntwà a an'dà ayà yàbulà an'kil.
Apan, mɛ kàwem un'kyeey awe anà ikɔ̈b udu a an'dà wàmutɛn naa: « Ngye ŋun'kyɛɛl, ngye awà, anà kàkäl, ngye awà wàbalàbal ntɔn kàtsül ngye nsaŋ ayi unsà balàbal.
Abun, baar bàtyaaŋ an'kil a baar angye anà mà aŋangɔɔm, anà apanà ngye amapà an'kil naa ba bànü. Ba ban'wal bweel aba! »
Ungö apan, mɛ kàwem ndaa yan'fà idwà yàmutɛn naa: « Inye, Mwol Nzam, Nkum a indiir byanswà, ntsüül a nsaŋ angye yà ndandaa anà yà balàbal! »
Un'kyeey wànà kàtyaaŋ kɔɔb ande udu a taaŋ. Ba bun'pɛ mbwo muwuul baar mbaa.
Baar bàwulà mbaa u mwäänà a ibaŋ. Ba bàbɛy ikɔb a Nzam awe anà ikɔ̈b udu a ntaaŋàmbar a tub ayi, wɛɛ ba bàsàbuul anki mpem ntɔn mukun'sà làkoo.
Un'kyeey wàtyeen kàtyaaŋ kɔɔb ande udu a kir a imfum a ntsür. Imfum a ntsür kya kyàbilà u làpib. Baar bàbebämà ndem aba an'din ntɔn usaay.
Ba bàtö Nzam a du ntɔn usaay aba anà inkyär aba. Wɛɛ ba bàwɛy anki nsyääl aba yà mbe.
Un'kyeey wàsyaam kàtyaaŋ kɔɔb ande u ngyäl Ɛfrat. Ngyäl awà kàkyer ayɔm ntɔn mupà mbwo akà amfum ban'fà ntsü làfàsɛnà taaŋ.
Apan, mɛ kàmɛn an'dweelà an'tär màŋingyäy, màŋàfyän an'kwar un'swaŋ, màyatoo u mun a dalàgɔ, u mun a ntsür anà u mun a ŋangɔɔm a loor.
Ma mà an'dweelà a insɔŋà amyà ifàkyer idiim a ubem. Mya myàfàkyà akà amfum a mɛɛn manswà ntɔn mukaköŋà ntɔn ità a ilä a kölàköl kyà Nzam awà Nkum a indiir byanswà.
Mwol kan'tɛn naa: « Le, mɛ an'yà asànaa mbüb! Un'sak akà mbuur awafàkal wàŋàpaŋà anà afàkaar ipfɛy ande, ntɔn nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n amɛɛy un'kwey ande. »
An'dweelà màtüüb amfum kà ikal mwɛy bàfàbel naa Armagɛdɔ kà Ɛbɛlyɔ.
Un'kyeey wànsambwaar kàtyaaŋ kɔɔb ande uboo a un'pöb. Ndaa mwɛy yàngwal yan'too kà idwà, yàfü kir a imwol yàmutɛn naa: « Yan'kwo! »
Apan, indiir bi byàkyer amɛnà: miŋyä, làso a ndaa, ipar, ntɛɛr a mɛɛn yà ngwal. Ntɛɛr a mɛɛn a tub ayi ŋàtàkal anki sɛmà abà baar udu a mɛɛn.
Bul a kölàköl làbaarà itiir itär, an'bul a nsi yanswà màkyer abwabà. Nzam kàdiimà anki bul a kölàköl Babilɔn. Nde kun'nüü kɔɔb a vin ande, vin a un'fur a nkyɛl ande.
Isaŋ a an'dà byàkyer adiimà anà myɔŋ myàfàmɛnà anki.
Ikül a mbul a in'kul kyàkyer anɔ, un'kul mwɛy buur awa bàkäl isi a an'kilɔ an'kwem an'nà. In'kul ami myafü du, waa myàbweelà baar, ba bàtöö Nzam ntɔn ya yàkäl ntaaŋàmbar a kölàköl.
